description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function' that extends 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor'. Its purpose is to format data values using user-defined PHP functions within a larger image graphing library. It includes methods to initialize with a function name and process input values by calling the specified function.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function
classes.description: A class to preprocess data values by applying a user-defined function, enabling custom formatting of data labels or values in image graphs.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function
methods.description: Constructor that sets the PHP function to be used for data processing.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Applies the user-defined function to a value to process/format it.
